channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: The period's clear win is regulatory approval of Esencia, a $2 billion-plus Mandarin Oriental/Rosewood resort and residential project on the southwest coast (Reuben Brothers, Three Rules Capital) — a major real-estate FDI signal after years of review. Smaller positives include Genera PR's exploration of desalination investment, a proposed DR-to-PR submarine power cable (2032 target), and DDEC/Tourism Company incentive programs (up to $10,000 per business, $2M pool) cushioning firms hit by water rationing. The dominant risk theme is the island's drought-driven water crisis — 48-hour rationing affecting 180,000+ households, a congressional/GAO probe into how $9 billion in post-María federal water funds were spent, and a fiscal oversight board warning that municipal construction taxes on federally funded projects (citing a $22.5M Siemens Energy dispute) could jeopardize recovery funds.
